covers: A roundup of six portable projectors from about $349 to $799 built from aggregated user reviews. Only some are native 1080p under $600, and the top pick is native 720p.
why: Review-aggregation roundup, no own testing; top pick is 720p, so it misses the 1080p constraint
title: The 6 Best Portable Projectors of 2026 (2,340+ Reviews Analyzed)
